description: Source code for the ClaimEventAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing claim events in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim events, with validation rules and annotations for OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPI
classes.description: API class for handling CRUD operations related to claim events, including creation, listing, retrieval by ID, updating, and deletion, with API documentation annotations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ClaimEvent object with name from request parameters and saves it via the claim service.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Populates a ClaimEvent object with description, status, and user information from request parameters and saves it.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim events based on search filters, pagination, and sorting, returning a collection result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getAll endpoint parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a claim event, including name and description.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs a validation rule for the name property, including length and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: getClaimEventCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Provides an entity unique property option that ignores deleted entities for validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes claim events with specified IDs after validating existence.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for delete operation, mainly the IDs array.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific claim event by ID, including usage check to determine editability.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a single claim event by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim event, with checks to prevent editing name if the event is used.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a claim event, including optional description and name.
